ahm…](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site/commit/eaf0f44f43c0c258f21f12125214468830b9e42c "A full Ahmia upgrade is coming: ahmia-index with Elasticsearch 8; ahmia-crawler with Scarpy2.11; and ahmia-site with Django5.") | 2 years agoFeb 27, 2024 | | [requirements.txt](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site/blob/master/requirements.txt "requirements.txt") | [requirements.txt](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site/blob/master/requirements.txt "requirements.txt") | [Update Django.](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site/commit/cfc8c7aadc3a5ef195f088552d90ff0952768aef "Update Django.") | 2 months agoMar 4, 2026 | | View all files | ## Repository files navigation - [README](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#) - [BSD-3-Clause license](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#) ![https://ahmia.fi/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ahmia/ahmia-site/master/ahmia-logotype.png) Ahmia is the search engine for `.onion` domains on the Tor anonymity network. It is led by [Juha Nurmi](https://github.com/juhanurmi) and is based in Finland. This repository contains crawlers used by [Ahmia](https://ahmia.fi/) search engine. # Compatibility [Permalink: Compatibility](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#compatibility) The newest version of Ahmia is built with Python 3, Django 5 and Elasticsearch 8. You will need to know these technologies to create a working Ahmia installation. Ahmia crawls using [ahmia-crawler](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-crawler). # Prerequisites [Permalink: Prerequisites](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#prerequisites) [Ahmia-index](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-index) should be installed and running # Installation guide [Permalink: Installation guide](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#installation-guide) ``` pip install -r requirements.txt ``` ## Configuration [Permalink: Configuration](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#configuration) This is a common step, both for local (dev) and production environment. ``` cp ahmia/example.env ahmia/.env ``` Please **modify the values** in `.env`, to fit your needs. You have to specify at least the postgresql credentials, if you are using the production settings. ## Setup Website [Permalink: Setup Website](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#setup-website) ### Migrate db [Permalink: Migrate db](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#migrate-db) ``` python manage.py makemigrations ahmia python manage.py migrate ``` ### Make the static files [Permalink: Make the static files](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#make-the-static-files) ``` python manage.py collectstatic ``` ### Copy Elasticsearch CA cert in place [Permalink: Copy Elasticsearch CA cert in place](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#copy-elasticsearch-ca-cert-in-place) ``` /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/http_ca.crt ``` # Run site in dev mode [Permalink: Run site in dev mode](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#run-site-in-dev-mode) ## Start development server [Permalink: Start development server](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#start-development-server) Development settings use sqlite as a database. Default settings should work out of the box. ``` python manage.py runserver ``` ## Production -- Nginx [Permalink: Production -- Nginx](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#production----nginx) **NOTE**: If your deployment directory isn't `/usr/local/lib/ahmia-site` replace accordingly - Configure and run nginx: ``` cp banned_terms.map /etc/nginx/ cp conf/nginx/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/nginx.conf cp conf/nginx/django-ahmia /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/django-ahmia service nginx start ``` Increase worker\_connections in /etc/nginx/nginx.conf: ``` events { worker_connections 2048; } ``` ## Production -- Gunicorn [Permalink: Production -- Gunicorn](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#production----gunicorn) EITHER: - Run gunicorn via bash scripts (work as daemons ~ edit files to change): ``` bash ./bin/run-ahmia.sh bash ./bin/run-ahmia-onion.sh ``` OR - **configure and** run gunicorn (tested with gunicorn==21.2.0) as systemd daemon ``` cp conf/gunicorn/*.service /etc/systemd/system/ systemctl daemon-reload systemctl enable ahmia.service systemctl status ahmia.service systemctl enable ahmia-onion.service systemctl status ahmia-onion.service systemctl restart gunicorn ``` ## Edit your /lib/systemd/system/nginx.service to add ahmia-site.service ahmia-site-onion.service [Permalink: Edit your /lib/systemd/system/nginx.service to add ahmia-site.service ahmia-site-onion.service](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#edit-your-libsystemdsystemnginxservice-to-add-ahmia-siteservice-ahmia-site-onionservice) ``` systemctl edit nginx [Unit] After=network-online.target remote-fs.target nss-lookup.target ahmia.service ahmia-onion.service Requires=ahmia.service ahmia-onion.service systemctl daemon-reload systemctl cat nginx ``` ## Delete added onions once a week [Permalink: Delete added onions once a week](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#delete-added-onions-once-a-week) ``` # Every three days 40 5 */3 * * cd /usr/local/lib/ahmia-site && venv/bin/python manage.py deleteonions >> weeklydelete.log 2>&1 ``` # License [Permalink: License](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#license) Ahmia is licensed under the [3-clause BSD license](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BSD_licenses#3-clause_license_.28.22Revised_BSD_License.22.2C_.22New_BSD_License.22.2C_or_.22Modified_BSD_License.22.29). ## About Ahmia.fi - Hidden service search engine [ahmia.fi](https://ahmia.fi/ "https://ahmia.fi") ### Resources [Readme](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#readme-ov-file) ### License [BSD-3-Clause license](https://github.com/ahmia/ahmia-site#BSD-3-Clause-1-ov-file) ### Uh oh!
